semantic_needs_review.summary:
Elena enters the sealed chamber beneath Saint Orison’s before sunrise and finds the remains of the seven children, the original attendance ledger, and Ada’s hidden correction page.

Gideon attempts to burn the evidence and stop Elena from reading the children’s names. Elena has already mailed copies of the recovered records to three outside authorities. She completes the chain by entering all seven names into the official death register and reading them aloud beneath the empty bell frame.

The final bell does not ring. Elena survives sunrise.

The remains are recovered, the 1974 deaths are formally recorded, Gideon is arrested after attacking Elena, and Ada’s role is exposed: she discovered the truth, concealed it for years, and finally altered the register to give Elena one chance to finish what she could not.

The immediate victim loop ends completely. The Saint Orison case is solved.
